approval_evidence.quote: Initial U.S. Approval: 2014 (Gardasil 9 prescribing information, FDA CBER; the fourth-quarter 2014 Merck release states GARDASIL 9 'was approved by the FDA in December 2014')

series_start_reason: Merck prints Gardasil 9 only inside a combined 'Gardasil / Gardasil 9' line (Product family: Gardasil quadrivalent plus Gardasil 9). That combined line first appears in the first-quarter 2015 release. Through the fourth-quarter 2014 release (accession 0001104659-15-006465) Merck printed a 'Gardasil' line that did not include Gardasil 9, a different definition, so it is not spliced onto this series. Searched: every 2014-2015 8-K item 2.02 EX-99.1 and the Q1 2015 10-Q; none prints Gardasil 9 separately.
search_log: checked every earnings release 2015Q1-2026Q2 for a separate Gardasil 9 line: none; the line is 'Gardasil / Gardasil 9' (spelled GARDASIL/GARDASIL 9 or Gardasil/ Gardasil 9 in some releases) throughout
the pre-2015 'Gardasil' line (2006 launch to 2014Q4) exists in the legacy filings and could be sourced as a separate Gardasil series; it was not included here
sum of the four quarters equals the printed full year for 2015, 2016, 2018-2020, 2023-2025 and differs by 1 (rounding) in 2017, 2021 and 2022

listed Merck & Co. (CIK 310158) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus every filings.files page), all forms, then kept 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02 and 10-Q/10-K. No 8-K/A lists item 2.02 (8-K/As 2006-2026 list only items 9.01, 7.01, 5.07 or 5.02); the 2019-02-01 8-K/A, filed the day of the Q4 2018 results, contains only an exhibit 99.2

legacy Merck registrant (CIK 64978, which before the November 2009 merger with Schering-Plough was a separate filer; CIK 310158 was Schering-Plough until then) listed the same way for 2006-2009 earnings releases and 10-Qs
downloaded the EX-99.1 of every item 2.02 8-K from 2006 to 2026-08-04 (85 releases); two item 2.02 filings (2013-02-19, 2022-04-21) are not quarterly results releases and carry no product line
read the product rows with scripts/build.py (HTML table rows, same row reading as the verifier) and cross-checked each quarter against the prior-year column of the following year's release

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: Series is the family line 'Gardasil / Gardasil 9', which includes quadrivalent Gardasil (U.S. launch 2006), so the family's first sale predates the series start; no cited document gives that quarter.; Grepped Merck FY2014 10-K, 2015 10-Qs, FY2015/FY2016 10-Ks and the Q4 2014/Q1 2015 releases for Gardasil 9 launch/availability language: only the Dec 2014 FDA approval is stated; no document states when Gardasil 9 first shipped or sold.; launch_quarter null.
